title: packages/dapi core: Hypergen model catalog, job/transcript types, MISSING_KEY, Whisper-to-transcript mapping; drop @diffusionstudio/api-contract from dapi and CLI
acceptance: All work only under E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3. Before writing any endpoint id, run GET https://api.fal.ai/v1/models?q=<term>&limit=50 and use only endpoint_id values that the response returns with an active status; record the verify date in a comment in models.ts.

models.ts is our own code (not copied from api-contract). It exports: HYPERGEN_MODELS (about 10-12 entries: nano-banana-pro with a text endpoint and the /edit endpoint used when images are given; one flux image model; kling v3 pro with t2v and i2v endpoints chosen by startFrame; veo3.1 fast (t2v + i2v); one seedance; an ElevenLabs TTS, music and sfx if fal lists them; bria background removal; seedvr image upscale, and seedvr video upscale only if fal lists it), MODEL_IDS, ModelId, Resolution, PromptMode/kind per model, a static etaSeconds per model, a pure toFalInput(request) per model that maps our request fields (prompt, images, aspectRatio, resolution, duration, count, voice, startFrame, endFrame, image, video) to that model's fal input field names (checked against the fal openapi via &expand=openapi-3.0), plus types GenerateRequest, Job ({id, model, request, status queued|running|succeeded|failed|canceled, etaSeconds, etaRemainingSeconds, phase, progress, assets[{url, filename, mimeType}], error{code,message}|null, createdAt}) and Transcript = TranscriptSegment[].

models.test.ts: catalog ids are unique; every fal endpoint id is unique per entry and matches /^[a-z0-9-]+\/[\w./-]+$/; no catalog id collides with LOCAL_MODEL_IDS (sam-2.1); toFalInput for nano-banana-pro with images selects the /edit endpoint and with no images the text endpoint; kling with startFrame selects i2v.

errors.ts: DapiErrorCode adds "MISSING_KEY" and removes "sign-in-required". A helper missingKey(provider: 'gemini'|'fal') returns a DapiError with code MISSING_KEY and message exactly 'Add your Gemini API key in Hypergen > Settings > AI providers.' / 'Add your fal.ai API key in Hypergen > Settings > AI providers.'; a helper fromWireError(message) turns a main-process error string that starts with 'MISSING_KEY: ' back into that DapiError (other strings -> plain Error). Both exported from index.ts and covered by a vitest test.

transcript.ts exports a pure whisperToTranscript(chunks: {text: string; timestamp: [number, number|null]}[], duration: number): TranscriptSegment[] (words trimmed, empty words dropped, a null end becomes the next word's start or duration, segments split on sentence-ending punctuation or a gap > 1 s). transcript.test.ts checks the exact output shape {text, words:[{text,start,end}]} that tools/transcribe.ts TranscriptSegment parses, including the null-end case and the empty-input case (returns []).

tools/generate.ts imports nothing from @diffusionstudio/api-contract; model enum = MODEL_IDS + LOCAL_MODEL_IDS; maxCredits and every credits field are gone; `estimate` returns only {etaSeconds}; GenerationEstimate in index.ts no longer mentions credits; description names Hypergen, the user's fal.ai key and MISSING_KEY, and says nothing about accounts or credits. local/fields.ts drops maxCredits.
apps/cli/src/index.ts drops --max-credits (keeps --estimate).
@diffusionstudio/api-contract removed from packages/dapi/package.json. `git grep -nIi "api-contract\|credits\|sign-in-required" -- packages/dapi apps/cli` returns nothing.
`npm test -w packages/dapi` passes (tools.test.ts updated to the new catalog and estimate shape).

DECISIONS (ADR-015): fal jobs are kept for the session only (no persistence); fal key Test uses a cheap authenticated request that returns 401/403 for a bad key, else Test reports 'saved'; Whisper MUST run in a Web Worker (new Worker(new URL('./whisper.worker.ts', import.meta.url), {type:'module'})) so the editor never freezes; brand/telemetry greps use word boundaries ( sentry ). Work only under E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3.

keys.ts: keys stored per provider ('gemini'|'fal') as safeStorage.encryptString base64 in <userData>/keys.json (path injected for tests), written atomically; status() returns only {gemini:boolean, fal:boolean}; no channel ever returns a raw key. keys.test.ts (safeStorage + fs temp dir mocked) covers set -> status true, file content is not the plain key, remove -> status false, corrupt/missing file -> both false, and safeStorage unavailable -> clear error.

fal.ts (fetch injected): submit POSTs https://queue.fal.run/{endpoint} with headers Authorization 'Key <key>' and Content-Type application/json, body = input, keeps {status_url, response_url, cancel_url} by request_id in memory; poll GETs the stored status_url and returns {status: IN_QUEUE|IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETED, queuePosition?, error?}, and on COMPLETED without error GETs response_url and returns files[] collected from images[], image, video, audio (each {url, contentType, fileName}); cancel PUTs cancel_url. fal.test.ts covers request shape, each status, the error case, result parsing of images[]/video/audio, and unknown request id.

gemini.ts (fetch injected): POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-flash-latest:generateContent with header x-goog-api-key and body {contents:[{parts:[{inline_data:{mime_type, data:<base64>}}, {text: prompt}]}]}; returns the joined candidate text; media > 20 MB is rejected before fetch with a clear message. gemini.test.ts asserts the exact URL, header and body shape, the 20 MB error, and a non-200 error message.
A missing key in any provider call throws an Error whose message is 'MISSING_KEY: ' + the WP1 missingKey(provider).message (tested for both providers, and fetch is not called).

PROVIDERS_KEYS_TEST: Gemini does an authenticated GET https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models; fal uses an authenticated request verified by hand to return 401/403 on a bad key (documented in a code comment); returns {ok:boolean, error?:string}.
